captions.text: A home screen / that knows your face. / What does it keep / when you [leave]?
captions.plain: A home screen that knows your face. What does it keep when you leave?

captions.text: Your messages and calendar: / its maker says they're / [not stored] on it.
captions.plain: Your messages and calendar: its maker says they're not stored on it.

captions.text: Your face? It says / nobody can see it. / How long it's kept: [not said].
captions.plain: Your face? It says nobody can see it. How long it's kept: not said.

captions.text: Its own ad ends with / the family watching / the daughter's boyfriend / [leave] on its camera.
captions.plain: Its own ad ends with the family watching the daughter's boyfriend leave on its camera.

captions.text: It forgets your data / when you leave. / And your [guests]?
captions.plain: It forgets your data when you leave. And your guests?

tag.text: A REAL AD, REMADE IN CLAY
